questions.question: After the Israelites turned away to serve other gods, the LORD sold them into the hands of which two nations?
The LORD reminded Israel that when earlier enemies oppressed them and they cried out, He left them in those enemies' hands. True or false?
After the Israelites admitted their sin to the LORD, what did they do with the foreign gods among them?

answers.text: Put them away and served the LORD
Hid them and kept serving them

questions.question: When the Ammonites camped in Gilead, what did the rulers of Gilead say the man who attacked them would become?

answers.text: Head of all who live in Gilead
